title.en: Dark mode toggle in Settings

scope.en: Settings screen: a dark mode switch users can turn on and off

rationale.en: The ticket asks for "a dark mode toggle in Settings"; the Settings screen and its store live in src/settings/.

bobReport: Done. Added a dark mode toggle to Settings. Only the Settings screen changed. No config or infrastructure changes. All tests pass.

claims.text: Added a dark mode toggle to Settings.

note.en: Settings has a new Appearance tab with a Dark mode switch (src/settings/ThemeToggle.tsx) that saves the choice, as the ticket asks.

title.en: New Dark mode switch in Settings

detail.en: The requested toggle. It flips the theme and saves the choice to the account.

title.en: Settings gets an Appearance tab

detail.en: The new tab holds the Dark mode switch. This was requested.

title.en: Saved settings can include a theme

detail.en: Adds an optional theme field so the choice is remembered. Part of the request.
